dict.string: Device Studio shows a local live preview while you adjust your camera. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
Device Studio records your microphone only while you are recording a meeting. The audio stays encrypted on this Mac and is never uploaded.
Device Studio records what your Mac plays, such as the other people on a call, only while you are recording a meeting. The audio stays encrypted on this Mac and is never uploaded.
Read Logitech hardware responses to show sensor DPI and battery status.
